create_calib_from_file: create a Calibration object from a KITTI calibration file path
convert_lidar_to_rect: convert lidar coordinates to rectified camera coordinates using the Calibration class
convert_rect_to_lidar: convert rectified camera coordinates back to lidar coordinates using the Calibration class
project_lidar_to_img: project 3D lidar points to 2D image coordinates using lidar_to_img
project_corners_to_boxes: project 3D bounding box corners to 2D image bounding boxes using corners3d_to_img_boxes
